mods.name: FTB Quests Bridge
mods.description: Loopback HTTP+JSON bridge for authoring FTB Quests content.

releases.notes:
First release of the `ftbquests-bridge` mod for **Minecraft 1.20.1 on Forge**, built against FTB Quests 2001.x and tested against **2001.4.11**. Ported by @mmyddd in #18.

On Minecraft 1.21.1 (NeoForge or Fabric)? Keep using [v1.1.0](https://github.com/west3436/ftbquests-mcp/releases/tag/v1.1.0). Nothing changes there.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.20.1 with Forge 47 or newer
- **FTB Quests 2001.4.11 or newer**, FTB Library, FTB Teams and Architectury API

The mod declares the FTB Quests version it needs, so on an older FTB Quests the loader stops at startup with a clear message instead of failing on first use.

## How it differs from the 1.21.1 bridge

- **Same API.** The HTTP routes and protocol (v1) are identical, so the Claude Code plugin works without changes.
- **Titles, subtitles and descriptions can all be written.** On 1.21.1 only titles can. The field shape depends on the object type:
  - a chapter's `subtitle` is a list of strings, and chapters have no `description`
  - a quest's `subtitle` is a single string and its `description` is a list of strings

  If you send the wrong shape, the bridge converts it and says so in a `warnings` array instead of silently losing the text.
- **`ftbq_health` also reports `minecraftVersion` and `ftbQuestsVersion`.**
- **A timeout (504) means the outcome is unknown.** A change that was already running may still have been applied, so read the object back before retrying.

## Install

Download `ftbquests-bridge-forge-1.20.1-1.2.0.jar` and put it in the server's `mods/` folder next to FTB Quests, FTB Library, FTB Teams and Architectury API. Start the server once. It writes `config/ftbquests-bridge.json` (settings) and `config/ftbquests-bridge/runtime.json` (port and access token), which is what the Claude Code plugin connects with.

Plugin setup is in the [plugin README](https://github.com/west3436/ftbquests-mcp/blob/mc1.20.1-v1.2.0/ftbquests-plugin/README.md).

releases.notes:
Compatibility release: the `ftbquests-bridge` mod now works with current FTB Quests releases (**2101.1.31 and newer**, built and tested against **2101.1.36**).

## Why upgrade

v1.0.0 was built against FTB Quests 2101.1.27. FTB reworked the quest-object API in 2101.1.28, so on newer FTB Quests every create failed with a 500 (`IllegalAccessError` / `NoSuchMethodError`) and deletes were broken (#15). v1.1.0 ports the bridge to the current API.

## Breaking change

**Requires FTB Quests 2101.1.31 or newer.** The mod now declares this as a required dependency, so on an older FTB Quests the loader stops at startup with a clear message instead of failing on first use. If you're stuck on FTB Quests ≤ 2101.1.27, stay on v1.0.0. 2101.1.28–2101.1.30 aren't supported by either version.

## Changes

- **Create, edit, delete and the quest map work again** on FTB Quests 2101.1.31+ (#15, #16).
- **Deleting a chapter group** removes the group and everything in it, including the chapters' `.snbt` files, so nothing comes back after a restart.
- **Edited titles reach connected players straight away**, instead of only after they log back in.
- Trying to delete the quest file itself or the default chapter group now returns a 400 error.
- **Fabric** has now been live-tested on a dedicated server, not just compiled.

## Install

Download the jar for your loader and put it in the server's `mods/` folder, replacing any older `ftbquests-bridge` jar. FTB Quests 2101.1.31+, FTB Library and Architectury API need to be there too.

- **Fabric** → `ftbquests-bridge-fabric-1.21.1-1.1.0.jar`
- **NeoForge** → `ftbquests-bridge-neoforge-1.21.1-1.1.0.jar`

The companion Claude Code plugin hasn't changed in this release, so there's nothing to update on the Claude Code side. Setup steps are in the [README](https://github.com/west3436/ftbquests-mcp/blob/v1.1.0/ftbquests-plugin/README.md).

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/west3436/ftbquests-mcp/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0

releases.notes:
First stable release of **ftbquests-mcp** — author and edit FTB Quests content on a **live** Minecraft server from Claude Code. Edits are applied through the server's own quest APIs and broadcast to connected players in real time.

The project ships two halves:

- **`ftbquests-bridge` mod** — a loopback HTTP+JSON API inside the Minecraft server (this release's downloadable artifacts).
- **`ftbquests` Claude Code plugin** — an MCP server exposing `ftbq_*` tools, the `ftbquests` skill, and the `/ftbq-status` and `/ftbq-new-chapter` slash commands.

## Requirements

- Minecraft **1.21.1** server (**NeoForge** or **Fabric**) running **FTB Quests** + **FTB Library** + **Architectury API**.
- **Node 18+** on the machine where Claude Code runs.

## Install the mod

Download the jar matching your loader and drop it into the server's `mods/` folder alongside FTB Quests, FTB Library, and Architectury API:

- **Fabric** → `ftbquests-bridge-fabric-1.0.0.jar`
- **NeoForge** → `ftbquests-bridge-neoforge-1.0.0.jar`

Start the server once to generate `config/ftbquests-bridge/runtime.json` (bridge port + auth token), then set up the companion plugin per the [README](https://github.com/west3436/ftbquests-mcp/blob/v1.0.0/ftbquests-plugin/README.md).

## Highlights

- Create, edit, move, and delete chapters, quests, tasks, rewards, and dependencies on a running server.
- Query the live registry (blocks/items) and FTB Quests task/reward type schemas.
- Loopback-only binding (`127.0.0.1`) for the SSH'd-admin scenario.
